newsitem.title: UK: UK's Halifax says house prices fall 0.1 pct in Sep.
newsitem.headline: UK's Halifax says house prices fall 0.1 pct in Sep.

text.p: The Halifax Building Society released the following seasonally adjusted UK house price data -
HOUSE PRICES (index base 1983=100) Sept Oct Sept,95
NOTE - The Halifax said this small fall reinforces its view that house prices are beginning to recover but that the boom in house prices which occured in the mid-1980s is not being repeated.
"This remains consistent with our forecast of a five percent rise in UK house prices over the whole of 1996," it said.
The Halifax added further evidence that the market recovering is given in the latest market transaction figures which have now been rising over the past five months.
Prices paid by first time buyers were unchanged in the month, reducing the annual rate of inflation in this sector to 4.8 percent from 5.9 in August.
